project.name: Third Eye
project.author: MTDI Studio reference project
project.description: MTDI 1 rebuilt on MTDI 5: two [[HC-SR04 ultrasonic]] rangers look left and right, and a buzzer beeps faster as the nearest object gets closer. The board warns on its own; MTDI learns the open space as the environment and shows which side something came from.

hardware.name: HC-SR04 × 2
hardware.role: Ultrasonic rangers · left and right · 2–400 cm

hardware.name: Buzzer
hardware.role: Warning · faster as things get closer

rules.text: Both echoes came well closer than the open space they learned: something is in front of both rangers, or the device itself turned to face a wall.
The left echo came well closer than its learned open space: something is on the left, or the left ranger is angled at a surface.
The right echo came well closer than its learned open space: something is on the right, or the right ranger is angled at a surface.
